jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI
jobs.description:
Enterprises are adopting AI faster than they can govern it — and they are looking for a partner who can do two things at once: speak credibly about AI trust, governance, and security, and actually build. The Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) is that partner.
You are the technical face of AvePoint inside client organizations: equally comfortable whiteboarding AI trust and governance concepts with a CISO, translating a business problem into a scoped AI build project, and writing the first working prototype yourself. You embed with clients, ship real outcomes, and own the engagement end to end.
This is not a pre-sales role with a demo script, and not a back-office delivery role. It is the engagement model pioneered by leading AI companies for their strategic enterprise customers: a senior engineer deployed forward, with the autonomy to own the problem from first workshop to production.
What you'll doAdvise on AI trust and governance. Lead workshops that help clients understand and take control of their AI landscape — agents, copilots, models, and the data behind them, including the shadow AI they didn't know about. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.
Scope and shape AI build projects. Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." Identify the highest-value use cases, define success criteria, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, estimable technical scopes — architecture outlines, data and integration requirements, delivery phases, effort and risk assessments. Write statements of work that engineering teams can actually deliver and clients can actually sign.
Build and deliver. Develop prototypes and production components for client AI solutions: agent workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, Anthropic), MCP-based tool integrations, and the governance and security controls around them. Deliver custom adapters and local tooling for regulated, cloud-restricted, or air-gapped environments where standard SaaS approaches cannot go.
Own the relationship through delivery. Act as the trusted technical advisor from first workshop through go-live: run enablement sessions, support adoption, troubleshoot in production, and expand the engagement where you see genuine value for the client.
What we're looking forMust-haves 5+ years in software engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting, with at least 2 years hands-on with modern AI/LLM systems in real projects (not only experimentation).
Practical experience building with LLM APIs and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel) and patterns such as RAG, agentic workflows, and tool/function calling.
Machine Learning Expertise:
Hands-on machine learning experience spanning model development, evaluation, deployment, and operationalization, with a focus on enterprise AI solutions, predictive analytics, and scalable MLOps practices.
Strong programming skills in Python and/or C#/TypeScript, plus working fluency with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including identity, networking, and data services.
Demonstrated ability to scope technical projects from ambiguous business requirements: you can run a requirements workshop, challenge assumptions constructively, and produce a credible plan with phases, estimates, and risks.
Excellent communication in front of senior stakeholders — you can explain why AI governance matters to a board member and debate vector database trade-offs with a platform engineer in the same meeting.
Willingness to travel to client sites and to operate with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving engagements.

Strong pluses Working knowledge of AI governance and compliance frameworks: EU AI Act, NIS2, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, or Gartner's AI TRiSM model.
Experience with AI security topics: prompt injection, data leakage, agent permissioning, model and data security posture (AI-SPM/DSPM concepts).
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent runtimes, or vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, Chroma).
Background in enterprise data governance, security, backup/resilience, or the Microsoft 365 / multi-cloud ecosystem where AvePoint operates.
Experience delivering into regulated industries (public sector, defense, financial services, healthcare) or air-gapped/sovereign environments.
Prior experience in a forward-deployed, embedded consulting, or customer-facing engineering role.
Additional languages relevant to your region's client base.

How we'll measure success Within your first 6–12 months, you will have led AI discovery and governance workshops for multiple enterprise clients, scoped and won at least one significant AI build or governance engagement, and delivered working software into a client environment. Above all: clients ask for you by name.
Why this role, why now AI adoption has outrun enterprise control, and regulators have noticed. Every large organization now needs to see, govern, secure, and sustain its AI estate — and most need a partner who can both advise and build. As an FDE at AvePoint you will help define this engagement model from the ground floor, work at the frontier of agentic AI and AI trust, and do it with two decades of enterprise data governance and resilience expertise behind you.

jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:

Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend
About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.

Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

mit architektonischem Verständnis.

Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich

Fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, JUnit, Git, relationalen Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL, MariaDB oder Oracle DB, Web-Technologien
Umsetzungserfahrungen in Architekturen und Frameworks wie JEE, Hibernate, JSF, Primefaces, React, Angular, JavaFX

Hohes Maß an Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
Attraktives Vergütungspaket

jobs.description:
Job description

mobile.de is Germany’s largest vehicle marketplace, with more than 1.6 million listed cars, commercial vehicles, motorcycles, and e-bikes (annual average 2025). Both private customers and registered vehicle dealers use the platform and benefit from more than 140 million visits per month*. As a “one-stop shop,” mobile.de’s offering includes not only buying and selling, but also financing and leasing solutions. Founded in 1996, the company is a subsidiary of Adevinta, a global leader in online classified portals.

Based in Berlin-Charlottenburg, we offer a dynamic environment where growth, learning, and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. If you are driven by an eagerness to disrupt, have a passion for collaboration, and are excited about shaping the future of mobility, we would love to hear from you.

We are looking for you, a proficient Senior Applications Engineer - Business Central to join our Business Systems & Integration department. You are passionate about technology and business solutions, with a strong interest in developing your expertise in both areas. You will develop and implement finance-related Microsoft Business Central solutions while building your system-related knowledge and skills.

Job requirements

Develop, implement and integrate technical solutions into Business Central together with other engineers and application managers
Collaborate with senior team members to provide technical support on system capabilities, configurations, and best practices to internal teams and stakeholders
Participate in reviewing technical implementations, code, and customizations with guidance from senior engineers
Support integration solutions between Microsoft Dynamics Business Central and other business systems, working closely with middleware engineers to ensure data integrity and system compatibility
Help create and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture diagrams and data flow models
Learn from and collaborate with team members on technical aspects of Microsoft Dynamics, contributing to a culture of continuous learning

Job responsibilities

3+ years of hands-on expertise in Microsoft Dynamics NAV and/or Business Central, including hands-on experience with customizations, extensions, and integrations.
Proficient knowledge of AL programming language and Business Central development tools
Experience with Azure DevOps and modern development practices
Understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, web services, and system integrations
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field; Master's degree preferred.

Job benefits

Working at mobile.de comes with its perks! Enjoy the following benefits (some of many):

Rewards: competitive base salary and participation in the company’s incentive programs.
Plan for the Future: On top of the statutory retirement insurance, we offer a competitive company pension scheme.
Team-Building: Regular team and company events offer the opportunity to network and learn from each other.
Learning & Development: Keep growing with access to coaching, learning platforms and resources.
Mobility: Stay mobile with a monthly transportation allowance.
Enjoy working: Our well‑equipped office supports focused work and teamwork - plus inviting social zones where colleagues can relax and connect

Wellbeing: confidential employee assistance and support services available to employees and their immediate families.

Meaningful Work
: We are a diverse, international, highly skilled and passionate team committed to a world where people share more and waste less. Every day you will have the opportunity to make a huge difference for our users, customers as well as shape the future.

Embracing AI

Being part of mobile.de you will work with and learn about AI tools, contributing to projects that leverage AI to enhance efficiency, improve customer experiences, and drive our mission forward. With an AI-first mindset, we foster a culture of continuous learning and experimentation, empowering our team to explore and apply AI in meaningful ways for the company and themselves.

Growth and Development
: We are a global organisation who truly believes in growing our people. To support this we offer lots of development and training opportunities and provide a budget for our team members.

Connection and Inclusion
: Our culture is the glue that holds us together. We believe in making meaningful connections and creating an inclusive atmosphere with lots of opportunities to connect both in your day to day work and through social team activities (online and offline).

jobs.description:
Over the past 30 years, we’ve grown from humble beginnings with a single computer into a diversified, global, technology-enabled lottery and prize draw company (ASX: JIN). Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.

Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

What will you be doing?

We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10)
Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role

Essential

Solid commercial experience with C# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
Comfortable working with front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

Mindset & Soft Skills

Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements-gathering to deployment.
Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross-departmental stakeholders.

Preferred:

Experience with Umbraco CMS
Experience with Blazor
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.

Our Ways of Working

At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

Why Join StarVale?

Find Your Freedom - https://bit.ly/Jumbointeractive

At StarVale, our team thrives because we invest in our people. Here’s what you can expect from us;

An annual regional bonus scheme that rewards your contributions, dependent on company performance.
25 days annual leave + public holidays + your birthday off.
Access to our Employee Assistance Program, providing counselling and coaching.
Reward & Recognition programme and length of service benefits.
The freedom to work from almost* anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks a year.

Candidates who are offered a position will be required to complete pre-employment checks through our partner, Checkmate, which will include referencing, Right to Work in the UK and DBS checks. We are, unfortunately, unable to offer sponsorship opportunities.

We are a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Gold Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job description:

Contract type: Permanent

Location: Edinburgh

Working style: Hybrid 50% home/office based

Closing date: 18th September 2026

Job Summary
Royal London is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join one of our application delivery teams within the Digital space at Royal London.
This role is focused on modern software and application engineering: designing, building and operating customer-facing and internal digital services with a strong emphasis on Azure-based application development using Angular and C#/.NET.
You will be a senior member of a cross-functional squad, contributing to solution design and delivery while remaining hands-on. You will build high-quality, secure and resilient applications, support engineering best practice, and help develop less experienced engineers through mentoring and collaboration.
This is an application-focused role, working closely with product, architecture, cloud and mobile teams to deliver valuable outcomes for customers and colleagues.

About the role  
Design, build, test and operate Angular front-end and C#/.NET back-end services deployed in Azure.
Contribute to technical design and impact assessments for changes to new and existing applications.
Produce and maintain technical documentation to the required standards.
Apply engineering best practices, including clean code, automated testing and observability.
Work closely with Architects, Testers, Product Owners, Analysts and stakeholders to deliver high-quality outcomes.
Support the day-to-day operation of live applications, including incident investigation, troubleshooting and resolution.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, helping to maintain engineering standards across the squad.
Mentor and support other engineers, contributing to a positive and collaborative engineering culture.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of software engineering practices within the wider Digital engineering community.

About you  
You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys designing and building well-engineered applications. You care deeply about software quality, security, resilience and operability, and you take pride in delivering maintainable solutions.
You are comfortable balancing:
Technical design and software development.
Delivery of high-quality outcomes.
Problem solving and continuous improvement.
Supporting and mentoring engineers within the team.

You thrive in a collaborative, product-focused environment where engineering judgement matters.

Essential Skills & Experience

Strong software engineering background, with experience delivering solutions across the full application development lifecycle.
Proven experience designing, building and maintaining modern web applications with strong expertise in either Angular (or similar front-end frameworks) or C#/.NET, and working knowledge of the complementary stack.
Strong experience building and running applications in Azure cloud environments, with an emphasis on application-level design, resilience and security.
Strong understanding of API-driven and service-based architecture.
Experience using CI/CD pipelines to build, test and deploy application code safely and repeatedly.
Strong focus on application quality including testing, performance, security, resilience and operational readiness.
Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions within an established architectural framework.
Experience supporting and mentoring engineers at different career stages.
A mindset of continuous improvement, actively developing your own skills and contributing to engineering best practice.

Nice to Have

Experience with common Azure services used in application delivery, such as App Services, Functions, Storage, Key Vault and Application Insights.
Experience with API Management (e.g. Azure APIM) as part of application integration.
Exposure to mobile application development (iOS, Android and/or cross-platform frameworks) or experience supporting mobile apps via backend services.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep or Terraform).
Experience building and supporting applications in regulated or security-conscious environments.

About Royal London  
We’re the UK’s largest mutual life, pensions and investment company, offering protection, long-term savings and asset management products and services.   

Our People Promise to our colleagues is that we will all work somewhere inclusive, responsible, enjoyable and fulfilling. This is underpinned by our Spirit of Royal London values; Empowered, Trustworthy, Collaborate, Achieve. 

We've always been proud to reward employees by offering great workplace benefits such as 28 days annual leave in addition to bank holidays, an up to 14% employer matching pension scheme and private medical insurance.

Inclusion, diversity and belonging  
We’re an inclusive employer. We celebrate and value different backgrounds and cultures across Royal London. Our diverse people and perspectives give us a range of skills which are recognised and respected – whatever their background.

Autodesk is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test with an interest in CI/CD and release engineering to help build the automated quality and software delivery systems for a new Electron-based desktop platform. CI/CD and build automation - approximately 30%: Develop and maintain continuous integration pipelines using Jenkins or similar systems. Automate build, test, packaging, artifact creation, and related engineering workflows

Collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and infrastructure teams to improve product quality and engineering productivity

Experience developing automated tests for software applications
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins, CloudBees CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar

Experience working with Jenkins or CloudBees CI pipelines
Familiarity with Windows code signing and software publishing workflows
Experience automating install, upgrade, uninstall, and application-startup scenarios

Experience investigating intermittent or flaky automated tests

You enjoy writing code that makes software development and testing more reliable. You are interested in understanding how software moves from a developer's change to a tested customer release, and you like working across test automation, build systems, and desktop application behavior.

About the team

The Ecotricity Technology department is a small friendly team with a strong focus on getting results, with everyone committed to delivering both individually and as part of the group/project.

We have a training programme in place to further advance your skills, with dedicated learning time planned into our workloads. Relevant training and certifications, including Databricks and AWS, are supported by the company, alongside opportunities to deepen applied AI and software engineering skills.

You will design and build end-to-end AI-enabled solutions on AWS and Databricks. Depending on the problem, this may pipelines, APIs, backend services and user-facing websites or applications.

We value sound engineering judgement over using AI for its own sake. You will select the simplest effective approach, prove value quickly, and then engineer for security, performance, cost, maintainability and scale. Experience in the energy industry is helpful but not essential.

You will work closely with product owners, project managers, subject-matter experts, data teams and other stakeholders. You will explain options clearly, demonstrate working software, gather feedback and translate it into measurable product outcomes.

This is a hybrid role, you will be self-motivated, delivery-focused and comfortable driving work independently. You will also contribute to shared engineering standards, review the work of peers and actively develop your own skills as AI tooling evolves.

If you want to build responsible AI products that move beyond prototypes and deliver tangible value in a dynamic, purpose-led organisation, we encourage you to apply.

Experience building and operating production software, data products or applied AI systems.
Strong Python, including experience designing APIs and integrating external services.
Practical experience with Databricks
Experience deploying secure, scalable workloads on AWS.
Understanding of applied AI and LLM patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, structured extraction and evaluation.
Effective use of AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex, with the judgement to review, test and own the resulting code.
Strong software delivery practices using GitHub or Bitbucket, automated testing and CI/CD.
Ability to build usable front-end web or app experiences using TypeScript, React or a comparable framework.
Clear communication, product thinking and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Advantageous

MLflow, RAG, Vector Search or comparable model and AI application tooling.
Terraform and automated AWS infrastructure delivery.
Container-based deployment, serverless services or modern application observability.
UX or product design experience for internal or customer-facing applications.
Experience of the energy industry or other regulated, data-sensitive environments.

About Us

What's in it for you...

Healthcare plan, life assurance and generous pension contribution

Volunteering Day

Hybrid Working

Various company discounts (including shops, gyms, days out and events)

Holiday of 25 days (plus bank holidays) & ability to buy/sell days

Cycle to work scheme, car pooling and onsite parking available

The fast moving nature of the business means that from time to time you may be asked to perform duties or tasks outside of your original job description on an ad hoc basis. This allows the company to utilise our people in the best possible way at all times and helps our colleagues to make the best contribution in a changing environment.

Ecotricity is Britain's overall greenest energy company- it’s more than just green energy – the breadth and depth of our work on green issues is unmatched. When we started back in 1995, we were the first company in the world to provide a new kind of electricity - the green kind.

Our mission was, and remains, to change the way energy is made and used in Britain - by replacing fossil fuels with clean, renewable energy.

We don't just supply green energy, we use the money from our customers' bills to make it ourselves too – we have built windmills and sun parks in Britain. We call this turning 'bills into mills'.

We don't just focus on energy though- we built the Electric Highway, Britain's leading network of electric vehicle charging points; we helped Forest Green Rovers become the greenest football club in the world; and we launched Britain's greenest mobile phone service, Ecotalk, where they use the money from their customers' bills to protect and regenerate Britain's lost rainforests.

jobs.title: Senior Software QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior QA Engineer

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer to design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for ETL pipelines and complex data processing workflows in the healthcare domain (Python, PySpark, Databricks). You will be responsible for ensuring the quality of platforms processing millions of medical records, with a strong focus on business rule validation and data integrity.

The Team

The Systems Engineering team is part of the Global Infrastructure & Operations (GIO) and remains one of the most dynamic and fast-growing groups in the organisation. We are passionate about Agile software development and are among the strongest advocates for DevOps and Test-Driven Development (TDD). Our culture promotes autonomy and collaboration, empowering individuals to thrive within self-organising teams. Our work involves processing and analysing a wide range of patient-level healthcare data, which supports solving complex healthcare challenges — from retrospective clinical studies to disease progression modelling.

In your daily activities, you will collaborate with a team of Architects who design effective solutions, and with the Development team, which ensures the highest standards of software.

The Data

We process over a billion records at a time, our engineers are responsible for the data analysis and construction and optimization of data flow processes. You will build data pipeline using ETL solutions for acquiring, processing and loading medical data into the Databricks using pyspark technologies.

Core Responsibilities

Design and maintain end-to-end validation across UI, REST APIs, SQL databases, and Databricks tables (cross-layer consistency).
Build and evolve ETL test automation for bulk/delta/rebulk processing, contract-check workflows, and QC report validation.
Implement metric service verification — validate calculated KPIs/metrics against source GDM/DPT data.
Develop custom Python libraries and Robot keywords for ADLS, Databricks, data comparison, and healthcare-specific validations.
Manage test data pipelines — CSV/JSON fixtures, VM file uploads, ADLS uploads, and environment-specific configuration via Vault.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD (Jenkins)
Ability to oversee and guide junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical direction and mentoring to support their growth 
Demonstrate strong attention to UI/UX detail — validate layout, visual consistency, loading states, filters, charts, and KPI presentation so the dashboard is accurate, intuitive, and aligned with clinical user expectations
Collaborate closely across disciplines — work effectively with other QAs, Product Owner, ETL/MS/UI developers, and UX designer to align on requirements, clarify acceptance criteria, share test coverage, and resolve defects efficiently across the full data-to-dashboard delivery chain
Balance competing priorities across parallel workstreams — plan and execute test coverage across UI, ETL, and MS scopes while multiple features, defects, and releases are in flight

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another related field

Essential

Technical skills and knowledge

6 years of experience in software testing

Test Automation: experience with Robot Framework or similar test automation tools
Programming Languages: Python (intermediate), SQL (advanced), familiarity with Java/Scala beneficial
Database Technologies: Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Databricks
Version Control: Git, GitHub/GitLab workflows, branch management
CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar pipeline tools
Test case design for complex data workflows
Defect tracking and management (JIRA, similar tools)
Container Technologies: Docker, container orchestration basics
Ability to present complex results in a clear language for both technical and non-
technical audience
Experience collaborating with teams from Europe, with an understanding of cross-cultural communication and remote delivery dynamics.
A great team player mindset.

Personal Skills And Behaviours

Excellent analytical & troubleshooting skills.
Strong collaboration, written and verbal skills.

Ability to present complex results in a clear language for both technical and non-

technical audience

Work in a company with offices in over 100 countries around the world, listed on the American stock exchange (NYSE)

Technical training

Support the development of proof-of-concepts / values (POC/Vs) of Infoblox solutions

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Practical AI fluency, with the ability to confidently use AI-assisted tools for technical analysis, demo preparation, solution design, and customer conversations, understanding both the capabilities and limitations of AI in enterprise networking and security contexts

Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment

Ideally some familiarity with Infoblox products or similar technologies or experience with networking labs, cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, or scripting, such as Python or Bash

Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work
Six Months:

Have a foundational knowledge of our product/solution portfolio
Demonstrate fluency with either on-prem or SaaS-based Infoblox solutions
Identify 1-2 specialisation areas
Capable of handling primary SE customer-facing tasks with help from others

Associate Sales Engineer - German/French/Italian/Spanish/Dutch speaker

We have an opportunity for a highly motivated and technically curious Associate Sales Engineer, fluent in German/French/Italian/Spanish/Dutch, to join our dynamic Enterprise Sales Engineering team in Warsaw, reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering for the region. In this role, you will work closely with experienced sales engineers and account executives to support the sales process and help customers understand the value of Infoblox solutions. You will also learn all aspects of the sales process and participate in Infoblox global technical training programs.

Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do

Assist in delivering technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective customers
Support the development of proof-of-concepts / values (POC/Vs) of Infoblox solutions
Collaborate with pre-sales solutions architects to gather customer requirements and map them to Infoblox’s offerings
Leverage defined pre-sales tools in customer engagements and supporting pre-sales solutions architects
Help respond to RFPs, RFIs, and other technical documentation requests
Learn and maintain a solid understanding of our DDI, DNS security, and cloud networking solutions
Leverage AI-enabled tools and platforms (including internal Copilot-style solutions) to accelerate technical discovery, tailor demos and POCs, analyze customer environments, and clearly articulate the value of Infoblox’s AI-driven networking and security capabilities
Participate in discovery calls and meetings to understand customer environments and challenges
Contribute to the creation of technical documentation, solution diagrams, and sales collateral
Enable partner technical sales teams on Infoblox solutions and positioning to customers

Be Prepared — What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role for a technology organization
Interest in networking, cybersecurity, or cloud technologies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Practical AI fluency, with the ability to confidently use AI-assisted tools for technical analysis, demo preparation, solution design, and customer conversations, understanding both the capabilities and limitations of AI in enterprise networking and security contexts
Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing
Fluency in English with German (or French/Italian/Spanish/Dutch)
Ideally some familiarity with Infoblox products or similar technologies or experience with networking labs, cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, or scripting, such as Python or Bash

Be Successful — Your Path

First 90 Days:
Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work
Six Months:

Have a foundational knowledge of our product/solution portfolio
Demonstrate fluency with either on-prem or SaaS-based Infoblox solutions
Identify 1-2 specialisation areas
Capable of handling primary SE customer-facing tasks with help from others

One Year:

Demonstrate fluency with all Infoblox solutions
Capable of handling advanced SE customer-facing tasks with only occasional help from others
Go-to person for specialisation area for the assigned region

Belong —
Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options

Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100672

We are seeking an Principal Solution Architect to lead the evolution of Autodesk Consulting’s Intellectual Property platform as an enterprise-ready SaaS product powered by knowledge architecture, AI-enabled capabilities, and future agentic applications.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, and consulting teams, you will design the knowledge architecture that connects workflows, data, decisions, and insights across the AEC, MFG, and M&E domains. You will establish the semantic models, knowledge graph capabilities, and platform architecture required to support organizational change management, workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications.

This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Sr. Manager, Architecture.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the architectural vision for Workflow Advisory and related knowledge-driven platform capabilities
Design semantic architectures, knowledge models, and knowledge graph capabilities that connect workflows, data, decisions, and insights
Define architecture patterns that enable workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications
Establish standards for knowledge representation, lifecycle management, governance, and reuse across platforms
Translate business workflows into reusable domain models, services, and architectural patterns
Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native architectures that support enterprise and customer-facing solutions
Ensure platform services, APIs, and knowledge assets are discoverable, composable, and consumable by AI-enabled applications
Apply AI and LLM technologies to improve knowledge discovery, workflow execution, and advisory experiences
Collaborate with architects and engineering responsible for ensuring architecture meets enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and SOC2 requirements
Collaborate with product, engineering, and consulting teams to align architecture investments with business outcomes and technology strategy
Drive adoption of architectural standards and reusable platform capabilities across teams
Mentor engineers and architects while communicating architectural direction to senior leadership and stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of experience designing and delivering complex software platforms
Experience as a Software Architect, Product Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent technical leadership role
Experience designing AI-enabled, knowledge-driven, or workflow-centric software systems
Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, ontologies, taxonomies, graph databases, or retrieval systems
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG architectures, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agent patterns
Experience leading technical spikes, rapid prototyping efforts, or proof-of-concept development
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices
Experience designing secure, privacy-conscious, and trustworthy software platforms that operate within enterprise governance requirements
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 15% of the time is required

26WD96547

Senior Principal Software Engineer (Backend/Full Stack)

Location:
Krakow, Poland (Hybrid)

Position Overview

Autodesk is expanding its engineering presence in Krakow and is looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer
(Backend/Full Stack) to help shape the future of our Smart Factory and Facility Operations platforms. While the target solutions are focused on Go (Golang) and React/JavaScript/TypeScript, we are open to candidates with experience in other technology stacks as well.

You will work across teams and disciplines to build our next-generation cloud web application platform – Tandem – that connects data and workflows across Industry 4.0, Industrial IoT (IIoT), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and Digital Twin solutions.

This is a high-impact technical leadership (tech lead) role focused on driving platform strategy and architecture (partnering with experienced Autodesk senior architects) and delivering scalable cloud-native services that support mission-critical customer workflows.

This is a unique opportunity to influence technical direction, solve complex software engineering challenges, and mentor engineers while remaining hands-on with design and development.

Join us in building software for people who design and make the world around us. From advanced manufacturing, sustainable buildings and resilient infrastructure to media experiences, Autodesk empowers innovators to solve complex challenges through technology.

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end delivery of major web application initiatives, from technical strategy and system design through implementation and operational excellence.
Design and build scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native services that support high-volume production workloads – with a focus on backend services while contributing to frontend development when needed.
Partner with Autodesk Architects and Engineering Leaders to define and drive the technical vision and architecture for critical platform services.
Contribute hands-on to software development across full-stack technologies with a focus on Go/C++ backends and React frontends (flexibly adapting to other technologies where appropriate)
Establish engineering standards, architectural patterns, and best practices that improve platform quality, reliability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering leaders to align technical investments with business objectives.
Guide teams through complex technical challenges, balancing long-term architecture with near-term delivery goals.
Lead design reviews, provide technical mentorship, and elevate engineering excellence across multiple teams.
Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
Champion operational excellence through observability, automation, reliability engineering, and continuous improvement practices.
Participate in Agile planning and execution activities while helping teams continuously improve delivery practices.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
12+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale commercial software systems.
Strong experience designing distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native web applications and APIs
Proven experience leading the architecture and delivery of complex software platform initiatives spanning multiple teams
Deep expertise in software engineering, with strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Go (Golang), C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, C#, Python, Java or similar (experience with Go and C++ is particularly valued)
Experience with any modern cloud platform such as AWS (preferred) or Azure.
Strong understanding of data architecture and database technologies.
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and modern software delivery practices.
Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with industrial and manufacturing domains (design, simulation, digital twin, operations), Smart Factory/Industry 4.0 solutions, Industrial IoT (IIoT), facility operations, asset management, AEC etc.
Experience with WebGL, 3D visualization technologies and micro-frontends.
Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and cloud observability practices.
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

jobs.description:
Svea Solar is on the verge of transforming how we manage energy with just the click of a button. We're here to help our customers make the most of their energy usage while also balancing the energy grid with smart, innovative solutions. To bring this vision to life, we're expanding our engineering team and are on the lookout for our next Backend Engineer.

About The Role & The Team

As a Backend Engineer, you'll join our Sunbeam Labs, where we’re creating digital services that range from energy optimization to virtual power plants. You’ll work closely with a talented and energetic team of engineers and domain experts, all focused on building cutting-edge software solutions that make energy optimization a reality for our customers.

In this role, you’ll be involved in every stage of the software development lifecycle, from brainstorming ideas to deployment and ongoing maintenance. Since we’re pioneering services that haven’t existed before, there’s plenty of room for discovery and problem-solving! You’ll be working with thousands of connected devices that we control in real-time, based on measurements taken multiple times per second. Your daily challenges might include figuring out how to distribute work among devices, handling AWS datacenter failovers without a hitch, counting milliseconds and megawatts, and even predicting tomorrow’s sunshine.

If you love tackling challenges, writing code, and having fun while doing it, this could be the

perfect fit for you!

🌍 Life as a Power Shifter - What do we offer you

The opportunity to make an impact
– your work directly contributes to fixing the planet and driving the energy transition.

About

A value-driven workplace
– read more about our values here.

The chance to own your results
– grow, take responsibility, and power up as both we and the energy industry evolve.

Diversity and inclusivity
– different perspectives drive innovation. Here, you can be yourself and contribute with your experiences, identities, and ideas.

Employment benefits
– occupational pension, 30 days of vacation, wellness allowance, parking, and more.

Flexibility / hybrid work
– work up to two days a week from home.

Want to see what life at Svea Solar really looks like? Follow us on Instagram: @LifeAtSveaSolar

Are we a match?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

You value team success over personal success
10+ years of experience as a backend developer, preferably with C#
You’re a strong problem solver who enjoys taking on challenges

Bonus points if you have:

Knowledge of cloud technologies (we use AWS)
Experience in the energy sector
Experience with Kubernetes and Docker
Experience with time series databases
Experience working with physical devices

We are a hybrid team that meets at our office in Alvik Strand 3 times a week.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to meet you! Join us on our mission to revolutionize home energy solutions and create a greener, more sustainable future.

⚡Who are we

As Sweden’s - and one of Europe’s - leading providers of energy tech and solar, we help our customers optimize their energy use with smart, connected solutions. From solar panels to heat pumps, batteries, EV chargers, and software, we’re shaping the future of energy. We call it The Power Shift
. And the ones driving it? Power Shifters
.

With structured interviews and assessments through Alva Labs, we make sure our recruitment process is fair, inclusive, and unbiased - because diversity is key to innovation!

at Humphree.

Lead, support and mentor a multidisciplinary team of software developers and testers
Build and nurture a high‑performing team culture where people feel motivated, safe and inspired

You understand that great software is built by great teams — and that leadership is about enabling people to grow, collaborate and succeed. You reflect on challenges from different angles and turn insights into decisions that help both the team and the product move forward.

You have confidence in your own technical background while staying curious and open to new perspectives. You enjoy connecting with people, building relationships and contributing to a positive team atmosphere. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you are comfortable asking for input as well as offering support.

As Humphree is a fast‑moving and innovative company, we believe you enjoy working close to both strategy and hands‑on development questions. You are comfortable switching between a high‑level view and detailed technical discussions when needed.

You are a natural and authentic leader with a coaching mindset. You listen well, communicate clearly and help ideas gain traction.

We believe you have:

A university degree (MSc or similar) within software engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or a related field

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher-value work.

The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.

At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

About the AI Hub

The AI Hub is a new function within People & Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.

We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.

The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

The role

Your users are your colleagues.
You'll build the systems, automations and AI-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.

This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.

Some examples of what is already live
This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:
An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.Your work will include:
Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.

Our technology stack

Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.

The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost-effective.

What we're looking for

We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.You'll likely bring:
Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C#.
Experience delivering AI-powered solutions that real users rely on.
Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
Awareness of the trade-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.
You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What success looks like

Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.

You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.
We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.

By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

Why join CatalystOne?

This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.You'll have the chance to:
Build solutions that create visible business impact.
Work directly with the people using what you build.
Shape how the AI Hub develops.
Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

As well as your salary, you’ll receive:
Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

jobs.title: CloudOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Acne Studios is a progressive luxury house and through collaboration and curiosity, we set high aspirations and strive for excellence. We value everyone’s contribution and embrace feedback to develop ourselves and others. We aim to minimise our environmental impact across all our operations and to address societal challenges in the way we conduct our business.

As CloudOps Engineer at our Stockholm office, you will manage and drive change in a modern, mostly cloud-based IT environment, covering servers, storage, micro services, networking, and end-user computing. The role also spans SaaS services, identity and access management, cyber security, enterprise mobility, vendor and supplier engagements, and procurement. Under broad direction, you will design and oversee upgrades, new installations, integrations, operations, and troubleshooting across Dev, Test, and Production environments.

CULTURE OF COLLABORATION

We firmly believe that when you feel supported, included, and trusted, it enables you to enjoy your work and thrive in it. You will be a part of a team of colleagues with diverse roles and backgrounds, each with their unique skills and experiences.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As CloudOps Engineer your main contribution will be to keep our network, cloud and endpoint services secure, stable and available, and to help move our remaining on-premises workloads to the cloud. You will report to the Infra Operations Manager. You will play a vital role in delivering a reliable, secure, and automated IT foundation for the business by:

Configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting network infrastructure across offices, stores, and warehouses, as well as networking in our public cloud environments
Planning and executing network changes and upgrades, monitoring performance and capacity, and carrying out root cause analysis on recurring faults
Administering our endpoint management platform and cloud identity services, including device compliance, application deployment, conditional access, and single sign-on
Operating compute, storage, and micro services in a cloud-first hybrid environment, together with our collaboration and productivity services, including backup and restore
Maintaining security compliance across networks, servers, and endpoints through patching, threat protection, hardening, and certificate management
Contributing to the migration of remaining on-premises workloads and services to the cloud, and to the decommissioning programme running until end of 2027
Taking part in Incident, Problem, and Change Management, acting as escalation tier for network operations, security operations, and customer support
Developing scripts for automation and monitoring, and keeping documentation and configuration data accurate in our ITSM platform
Collaborating with development, service delivery, and business teams to keep critical systems available around the clock, including taking part in the on-call rotation and travelling to sites when required

WHO YOU ARE

You have high aspirations and focus on details that create substantial impact. You enjoy working as a team and you embrace feedback to develop yourself and others. You are curious and thrive in a dynamic environment. Cooperation, respect, and clear communication are important, along with your ambition to learn and grow.
